releaseNotes: Release 2.0.5: CapCut-style Fold/Unfold dedicated sub-timelines (Overlay, Audio, Text), 4K 60fps zero-copy SurfaceView hardware playback with decoder fallback, visible Text rendering on canvas & timeline, Keyframe button next to Undo/Redo, precision playhead splitting and ultra-thin 1dp line, smooth multi-overlay dragging and up to 10x scaling.
